initialPrompts.name: 01-capture-workflow
initialPrompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity product UI design board for Preround, an existing browser-local clinical note-writing app. These are proposed screens, not screenshots. Flat front-on, crisp readable UI, no device photographs, no perspective. Consistent calm light interface: white surfaces, soft neutral background, dark charcoal typography, restrained teal primary actions, amber unresolved states. Modern humanist sans-serif, accessible contrast, roomy controls, thin dividers, modest corner radius, no marketing decoration. Text should be short and legible. Use ONLY fictional content labeled "Synthetic case". No real names, MRNs, dates of birth or institutional logos. No accounts, cloud sync, server storage, analytics, inferred timeline or autonomous clinical decisions. Patient content lives only in an encrypted local vault; raw imported originals are memory-only. Explicit patient and user-labeled packet context. Persistent navigation after unlock: Patients, Write note, Reference, Tools; Settings and Lock vault secondary. Use textual state labels in addition to color.
Asset type: Landscape workflow board, 3 clearly numbered screen mockups in reading order with short connecting arrows, detailed enough to see controls, large high-resolution composition. Title "01 / From chart to reviewed sources".
Screen 1 "Unlock your vault": focused full-screen unlock with masked passphrase, Show, Unlock, Restore encrypted backup, secondary recovery link. Absolutely no patient names or patient navigation behind the locked screen.
Screen 2 "Choose a packet": unlocked Patients view with Synthetic case A and Synthetic case B, status "Draft in progress"; new patient label field, selected case opens packet selector "Admission" / "Day 2 — user label", primary "Add chart text". Show an import drawer with chart text area, source type choice, model control "Stanford · Ready locally", primary "De-identify". Small caption "Original text stays in this tab". A compact download state inset shows progress and Cancel / Retry; processing disabled until ready, never automatic fallback.
Screen 3 "Review redactions": annotated synthetic document with struck-through placeholder beside [NAME], next pending decision highlighted, progress "2 of 3 reviewed", Accept / Keep original / manual Redact selection, accepted replacement exposes Undo. Warning "1 item needs review", action Redact / Not PHI. Bottom "Save reviewed sources" and secondary Back, preview of exactly what will be saved. Privacy state labels clear, not alarmist.
Footer flow "Unlock → Select packet → De-identify → Review → Write".

Asset type: One large landscape desktop application screen, maximum readable fidelity. Board title "02 / One workspace for writing".
Compact left app navigation with Write note active. Persistent top bar "Synthetic case A" and packet selector "Day 2 — user label", note type "Progress note", status "Saved locally", Lock.
Main layout sources pane about 30%, editable note 50%, contextual source drawer 20%. Sources pane tabs "This packet" and "Compare"; categories Vitals, Labs, Medications, Notes; search; concise rows and source checkboxes. "Compare with: Admission" explicitly user-selected. Small amber "Changed since selected packet" badge, not inferred chronology.
Central note is the visual focus with title "Progress note", section jump links Summary / Subjective / Objective / Assessment & Plan; natural text editing, unused sections collapsed. Synthetic sample "Reports improved breathing." Mark a source chip "Nursing note · This packet"; selected statement in note opens right drawer "Source" with exact excerpt, source label, packet, "Use this text" and close. A problem card "Breathing concern" has clinician-authored assessment and restrained action "Assist". Menu shows Draft from selected facts, Shorten, Update from packet, Check contradictions, Suggest plan additions. Do not invent diagnoses, treatments, exam normals, units or absent data. Small badges distinguish "From source", "Your text", "AI suggestion". Bottom sticky bar Undo, Preview, primary "Review & copy".
Add 3 compact numbered annotations OUTSIDE application frame: "Keep context visible", "Verify any imported fact", "Edit in place". No whole-note quality score, dashboards, charts or giant cards.

Asset type: Landscape two-screen workflow board with legible detail. Title "03 / Review changes before they enter the note".
Left screen "Focused AI assistance": same Preround shell and Synthetic case A / Day 2 context. Note alongside Assist drawer. Task "Shorten without changing meaning", included sources list with checkboxes, editable instruction "Keep the clinical meaning. Do not add findings.", editable selected input. Destination labeled "OpenAI · Sends selected de-identified text"; alternative "Copy prompt" available without key. Advanced accordion collapsed with model, temperature, web search, exact request beneath; primary "Review request", then small inset request review state with "Send request" disabled and "Add API key in Settings". Below show example returned suggestion marked "Illustrative suggestion": Before "The patient reports that breathing feels better." After "Reports improved breathing." Source excerpt and buttons Accept / Edit / Dismiss, accepted state Undo. No automatic incorporation.
Right screen "Review & copy": beautiful plain-note preview, no editing widgets in export, "Synthetic case A · Day 2", side panel "Before copying", 3 specific checks: amber "1 carried-forward statement needs review", amber "1 conflicting source", neutral "No unaccepted AI suggestions included". Each has "Go to section". Distinguish "Detected by field checks" from "Suggested by AI". Missing content remains missing. Bottom controls "Back to edit", "Copy for Epic", dropdown Plain text / Rich text, "Download .txt"; small "Copied" toast in separate inset, no auto-send to EHR. Footnote "Only accepted note content is exported". No invented clinical quality percentage.

Phone 1 Patients: Synthetic case A, Synthetic case B, short user packet labels, "Resume draft", Add patient, Lock vault. No beds or identifying names.
Phone 2 Sources: pinned Synthetic case A / Day 2 header, Sources / Note / Preview segmented tabs, Sources active. Compact saved-source cards, one expanded "Nursing note" excerpt "Reports improved breathing.", "Include in note" checkbox, compare selector, Add source sticky button.

A slim bottom app navigation Patients / Write / Reference / Tools remains consistent. Small labels beneath screens "Resume", "Verify", "Write", "Copy". Preserve work and scroll when switching tabs. No cloud or account controls.

initialPrompts.name: 05-preferences-and-supporting-tools
initialPrompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity product UI design board for Preround, an existing browser-local clinical note-writing app. These are proposed screens, not screenshots. Flat front-on, crisp readable UI, no device photographs, no perspective. Consistent calm light interface: white surfaces, soft neutral background, dark charcoal typography, restrained teal primary actions, amber unresolved states. Modern humanist sans-serif, accessible contrast, roomy controls, thin dividers, modest corner radius, no marketing decoration. Text should be short and legible. Explicit patient and user-labeled packet context. Persistent navigation after unlock: Patients, Write note, Reference, Tools; Settings and Lock vault secondary. Use textual state labels in addition to color.
Asset type: Landscape three-screen board, legible high-fidelity application UI, title "05 / Defaults, references, and recovery".
Screen 1 Settings: left groups Writing defaults / AI & models / Vault. Writing defaults active, note format Progress note / H&P, saved editable "A&P instructions" text area, guideline sets editable list Admission / Progress / Discharge, Save defaults and Restore default. Advanced model controls tucked away. Show local-model status inset "Stanford · Verified locally"; Download progress / Cancel / Retry labeled. A separate on-device chat inset "Model not installed", Get model, disabled Send. Never advertise a failed model as ready.
Screen 2 Reference & Tools: Reference tab with search "Chief complaint", read-only result "Breathing symptoms", compact "Listen for", "How to", "Why it matters" sections, no patient data or input forms in reference. Clearly separate Tools tab inset with Calculators / Drug lookup / Chat / Scribe. Calculator preview marks "Manual input" versus "From saved source — verify", never silent autofill; small example APGAR form, no prescribing advice.
Screen 3 Vault & recovery: unlocked settings panel Encrypted backup / Restore encrypted backup / Lock vault, clear local storage explanation. Below visual state cards "Save failed — Retry", "Model load failed — Retry or choose another model", "Offline — Local tools available", "Vault locked — Unlock". When locked no patient or note content visible. User sees recoverable actions, no silent fallback, no new accounts, server or synchronization controls.
Footer "Supporting tools stay one step away from writing".

corrections.name: 01-capture-workflow
corrections.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Edit this design board only to correct workflow text and state accuracy; preserve the three-panel layout, typography, teal palette and all other styling. Replace recovery-phrase copy with "Your passphrase cannot be recovered." and "Delete vault and start over" as a secondary destructive recovery link. There is NO recovery phrase. In all note excerpts replace redacted drug placeholder "[DRUG]" with plain "penicillin" and remove strikethrough from penicillin: medications/allergies are clinical content not PHI. Accepted replacement card must show only "[NAME]" and Undo, never the original struck-through name. Keep the review in a consistent pending state: "2 of 3 reviewed", "1 item needs review", saved preview label "Preview after pending decision", disabled "Save reviewed sources" until resolved. Add small "Synthetic example" label above the review document. Preserve everything else.

corrections.name: 03-assist-and-export
corrections.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Correct text only in this existing Preround design board, preserving layout and styling. On right exported-note panel replace the long invented clinical note with a short synthetic example: title "Synthetic case A · Day 2"; "Subjective" followed by "Reports improved breathing."; "Objective" followed by "No findings entered."; "Assessment & Plan" followed by "Breathing concern" and "Clinician assessment and plan not yet entered." Do not invent exam normals, diagnoses, antibiotics, oxygen or other treatment. Add small caption "Illustrative draft — missing content stays missing". In left advanced controls replace model-specific/version text with "Model: selected in Settings | Temperature: default | Web search: Off". Change bottom green accepted toast to "Accepted change added to draft." with Undo. On right move "No unaccepted AI suggestions included" under field checks and use AI section text "Potential source conflict — verify" (AI finding not a proven fact). Keep export buttons and all other layout consistent.

corrections.name: 05-preferences-and-supporting-tools
corrections.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Edit only state labels and inaccurate text in this Preround board; preserve layout and styling. Under Stanford Verified locally change descriptive text to "De-identification model". Make the progress inset a clearly separate example state titled "Download state example", text "Downloading model files · 62%", remove the invented 3.4 GB size, keep Cancel and disable Retry during progress. Save failed notice must say "Changes are not saved. Keep this tab open and retry." Never promise unsaved changes are durable. Offline notice says "Downloaded local tools are available." Add caption above status cards "Separate states — not shown simultaneously". Delete the invented tagline under Preround at top. Keep everything else unchanged.

finalCaptureCorrection: Use case: ui-mockup. Make exactly these small corrections to this board while keeping all other pixels/layout/text unchanged: In the LEFT unlock panel replace the bottom duplicate "Forgot your passphrase?" link and explanatory line with a clear secondary outlined button "Restore encrypted backup". Keep Unlock and existing destructive recovery message/button. In the RIGHT document, remove the horizontal strikethrough line crossing the word "penicillin": render Allergy: penicillin. as ordinary black text, with NO strike, replacement, highlight or redaction. The accepted [NAME] in the document should display only [NAME], not John Doe beside it. Keep the pending hospital original and replacement. Do not remove any existing controls.
